[PREFERENCE] User enjoyed the combination of the environmental focus and the adventure aspect in "The Last Mountain."

[EVENT] User is looking for recommendations for films or events to check out at SIFF.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "The Last Mountain" is a great documentary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended documentaries similar to "The Last Mountain" include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Meru" (2015) - A documentary about climbers attempting to conquer a peak in the Indian Himalayas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "The River Runs Red" (2019) - A documentary exploring the environmental and social impact of the damming of the Mekong River.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "The True Cost" (2015) - A documentary examining the environmental and social consequences of the fast fashion industry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Racing Extinction" (2015) - A documentary exposing the extinction of various species and the impact of human activity on the environment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Chasing Coral" (2017) - A documentary documenting the decline of coral reefs around the world.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. "The Cove" (2009) - A documentary exposing the annual dolphin hunt in Taiji, Japan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. "If a Tree Falls: A Story of the Earth Liberation Front" (2011) - A documentary about environmental activism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. "The 11th Hour" (2007) - A documentary exploring the state of the natural world and human impact on the environment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested more documentaries similar to "Meru" include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Valley Uprising" (2014) - A documentary about the history of rock climbing in Yosemite National Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "The Dawn Wall" (2017) - A documentary following climbers Tommy Caldwell and Kevin Jorgeson.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Free Solo" (2018) - A documentary following Alex Honnold's climb of El Capitan without ropes.
